```{r}
taipei_land_files <- c("a_lvr_land_a.csv")

if (!all(taipei_land_files %in% names(real_estate_data))) {
  stop(
    "These files were not found in real_estate_data: ",
    paste(setdiff(taipei_land_files, names(real_estate_data)), collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable files include: ",
    paste(head(names(real_estate_data), 20), collapse = ", "),
    if (length(names(real_estate_data)) > 20) " ..."
  )
}

taipei <- taipei_land_files %>%
  lapply(function(file) {
    df <- real_estate_data[[file]]

    colnames(df) <- as.character(unlist(df[1, ]))
    df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]

    df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "The villages and towns urban district",
        "main use",
        "the unit price (NTD / square meter)"
      )))
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

taipei <- taipei %>%
  filter(`main use` %in% c("住家用", "住商用", "住工用")) %>%
  rename(
    District   = `The villages and towns urban district`,
    LANDPRICE  = `the unit price (NTD / square meter)`
  )

taipei_ave_price <- taipei %>%
  group_by(District) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(parse_number(LANDPRICE), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = "臺北市"
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, avg_price)

taipei_ave_price

```

```{r}
taipei_pop_data <- aging_data %>%
  mutate(
    COUNTY = str_replace_all(COUNTY, "台", "臺")
  ) %>%
  filter(COUNTY == "臺北市") %>%
  select(any_of(c("COUNTY", "TOWN", "A65UP_A15A64_RAT"))) %>%
  mutate(
    A65UP_A15A64_RAT = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(A65UP_A15A64_RAT))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Region   = COUNTY,
    District = TOWN
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, A65UP_A15A64_RAT)

taipei_pop_data
```

```{r}
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
}
```

```{r}
df_med <- bind_rows(
  medical_data$medical_center %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "醫學中心"),
  medical_data$hospital_regional %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "區域醫院"),
  medical_data$hospital_local %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "地區醫院"),
  medical_data$clinic %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "診所"),
  medical_data$pharmacy %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "藥局")
)
```

```{r}
medical_summary <- df_med %>%
  mutate(
    地址 = iconv(地址, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = ""),
    地址 = str_replace_all(地址, "台", "臺"),
    Region = str_extract(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
    Address_Clean = str_remove(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
    District = str_extract(Address_Clean, "^.+?[區鄉鎮市]"),
    Weight = case_when(
      Level == "醫學中心" ~ 10,
      Level == "區域醫院" ~ 5,
      Level == "地區醫院" ~ 3,
      Level == "診所" ~ 1,
      Level == "藥局" ~ 0.5,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Region), !is.na(District)) %>%
  group_by(Region, District) %>%
  summarise(
    Medical_Score = sum(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    Facility_Count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

medical_taipei <- medical_summary %>%
  filter(Region == "臺北市") %>%
  select(Region, District, Medical_Score, Facility_Count)

medical_taipei
```

```{r}
taipei_core <- taipei_pop_data %>%
  inner_join(taipei_ave_price, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
  left_join(medical_taipei, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
  mutate(
    Medical_Score = replace_na(Medical_Score, 0),
    Facility_Count = replace_na(Facility_Count, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_price = if_else(is.finite(avg_price) & avg_price > 0, avg_price, NA_real_),
    Log_Price = log(avg_price),
    Log_Medical = log(Medical_Score + 1),
    Aging_Burden = A65UP_A15A64_RAT
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Log_Price),
    is.finite(Log_Medical),
    !is.na(Aging_Burden)
  )

taipei_core
```

```{r}
library(biscale)

get_bi_palette <- function(pal = "DkBlue", dim = 3) {
  p <- bi_pal(pal = pal, dim = dim, preview = FALSE)

  if (is.function(p)) p <- p(dim * dim)

  if (is.null(names(p))) {
    names(p) <- c(
      "1-1","2-1","3-1",
      "1-2","2-2","3-2",
      "1-3","2-3","3-3"
    )
  }
  p
}

pal_vec <- get_bi_palette("DkBlue", 3)

labels_need_care <- c(
  "1-1" = "Low need / Low care",
  "1-2" = "Low need / Mid care",
  "1-3" = "Low need / High care",
  "2-1" = "Mid need / Low care",
  "2-2" = "Mid need / Mid care",
  "2-3" = "Mid need / High care",
  "3-1" = "High need / Low care (Inverse care)",
  "3-2" = "High need / Mid care",
  "3-3" = "High need / High care"
)

```

```{r}
# 1) Choose the township/district boundary layer, filter to Taipei City
town_sf <- map_data[["TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp"]] %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(
    TOWNNAME_key = str_squish(TOWNNAME),
    COUNTYNAME_key = str_replace_all(str_squish(COUNTYNAME), "台", "臺")
  )

town_sf_taipei <- town_sf %>%
  filter(COUNTYNAME_key == "臺北市")

```

```{r}
# 2) Join taipei_core onto polygons
core_keyed <- taipei_core %>%
  mutate(
    TOWNNAME_key = str_squish(District),
    Aging_Burden = as.numeric(Aging_Burden),
    Medical_Score = as.numeric(Medical_Score)
  )

joined_sf_taipei <- town_sf_taipei %>%
  left_join(
    core_keyed %>% select(TOWNNAME_key, Aging_Burden, Medical_Score),
    by = "TOWNNAME_key"
  )

anti_join(
  core_keyed %>% distinct(TOWNNAME_key),
  town_sf_taipei %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% distinct(TOWNNAME_key),
  by = "TOWNNAME_key"
)

```

```{r}
# 3) Bivariate classification (Need vs Care)
map_need_care_taipei <- joined_sf_taipei %>%
  filter(!is.na(Aging_Burden), !is.na(Medical_Score)) %>%
  bi_class(x = Aging_Burden, y = Medical_Score, style = "quantile", dim = 3)

```

```{r}
# 4) Plot with district labels placed inside polygons
map_need_care_taipei_lab <- map_need_care_taipei %>%
  mutate(label_pt = st_point_on_surface(geometry)) %>%
  st_set_geometry("label_pt")

ggplot(map_need_care_taipei) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = bi_class), color = NA) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = map_need_care_taipei_lab,
    aes(label = TOWNNAME),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal_vec,
    breaks = names(labels_need_care),
    labels = labels_need_care,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bivariate Map: Need vs Care (Taipei City)",
    subtitle = "Need = Aging_Burden; Care = Medical_Score (3x3 quantiles)",
    fill = "Need–Care"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}


library(ggrepel)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Project to a meter-based CRS so repelling behaves well
map_poly <- map_need_care_taipei_en %>%
  st_transform(3826)  # TWD97 / TM2 zone 121 (meters)

# Build a label table with explicit x/y coordinates
label_df <- map_poly %>%
  mutate(label_pt = st_point_on_surface(geometry)) %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(label_pt)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(label_pt)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(TOWNNAME_EN, x, y)

ggplot(map_poly) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = bi_class), color = NA) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = TOWNNAME_EN),
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    force = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.alpha = 0.4,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal_vec,
    breaks = names(labels_need_care),
    labels = labels_need_care,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bivariate Map: Need vs Care (Taipei City)",
    subtitle = "Need = Aging_Burden; Care = Medical_Score (3x3 quantiles)",
    fill = "Need–Care"
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(map_poly)) +
  theme_minimal()

```
